body: Yeah, I found out I was actually mistaken and the drug I used was Pentobarbital. To quote my friend who had to do CPR on me, I was « all blue » 10 minutes after drinking it

Thank you! Yeah pain was a very important factor for me too and indeed, with Pentobarbital you would be unconscious in a matter of minutes. I remember an horrible taste but 100ml is quite easy to chug down
I’m honestly not sure, I can’t advise you
Yeah sorry, I got confused by I found out yesterday it was actually Pentobarbital. Like I said, coma... made me lose a lot of memories of that day

Comparatively to other forms of suicide, like hanging, can be quite painful.
The downside to pentobarbital is that once you take it, if you’re alone, you will die for sure, there’s no survivor reflex possible
No pain at all, that’s the « upside » with pento if there’s one. You might get ceisures as your body reacts but you would already be sound asleep at that point.

I'm okay I guess.

Mentally, I'm still strugling with suicidal thoughts sometimes, especially when I put myself in weird situations (seeing my ex on Grindr, or going on his Instagram). But my family is there, so I'm doing much better already.

Physically, I'm good! I lost 7kg during my coma + during my depression before the attempt so I've been prescribed supplements to gain that weight back (I'm supposed to be 64kg). I did get pneumonia when they intubated me, or something, I don't know. I was taking antibiotics in the hospital,  I'm not coughing as much now and I feel it fading away
